narrative_vs_numbers.summary: Eternal Limited has consistently executed on its strategic promises across food delivery and quick commerce, achieving quick commerce EBITDA breakeven ahead of expectations while transitioning over 80-90% of Blinkit to a 1P inventory model. Management successfully accelerated quick commerce QoQ volume growth to 21% in Q1 FY27 and upgraded its long-term quick commerce EBITDA margin guidance target to 6%.

guided.metric: Quick Commerce Sequential Volume & Margin Guidance
guided.guidance: Expectation of meaningful acceleration in QoQ growth driven by summer seasonality and long-term margin target band of 5-6%.
guided.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (06-May-2026), p. 3 — "seeing a meaningful expectation of acceleration in quarter-on-quarter growth"

delivered.metric: Quick Commerce Sequential Volume & Margin Guidance
delivered.actual: Delivered 21% QoQ volume growth in Blinkit and raised the long-term margin guidance to 6%.
delivered.source: Q1 FY27 Concall Transcript (29-Jul-2026), p. 7 — "you did deliver 21% QoQ volume growth"

quarters.commentary: Management delivered strong sequential volume expansion in quick commerce, exceeding market expectations and prompting an upward revision in long-term margin target.

guided.metric: Dark Store Expansion & Long-Term Growth Guidance
guided.guidance: Remained on track to achieve 3,000 dark stores with a three-year NOV CAGR target of 60%.
guided.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (06-May-2026), p. 3 — "On store addition, we're on track on our guidance for March of 3,000 stores."

delivered.metric: Dark Store Expansion & Long-Term Growth Guidance
delivered.actual: Sustained dark store buildout momentum while formalizing a 60% multi-year growth CAGR benchmark.
delivered.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (06-May-2026), p. 3 — "given overall guidance of 60% CAGR"

quarters.commentary: Management reaffirmed its dark store network target while laying out a clear three-year growth roadmap.

guided.guidance: Planned store network expansion toward 2,100 stores by Q3 FY26 while expanding contribution margins.
guided.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (23-Oct-2025), p. 10 — "plan to operate around 2,100 stores by the December quarter"

delivered.actual: Added 211 net dark stores in Q3 FY26 and achieved Adjusted EBITDA breakeven in Blinkit.
delivered.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (27-Jan-2026), p. 15 — "you had 211 net store additions"

quarters.commentary: Management achieved dark store net additions as planned and successfully reached profitability breakeven in quick commerce.

guided.guidance: Targeted moving the majority of quick commerce business to 1P inventory ownership over 2-3 quarters.
guided.source: Q1 FY26 Concall Transcript (25-Jul-2025), p. 3 — "we should be able to move most of our business to inventory ownership"

delivered.actual: Shifted 80% of business to 1P inventory model in Q2 FY26, resulting in immediate top-line expansion.
delivered.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (23-Oct-2025), p. 5 — "because of the step change of 80%, you saw the revenue growth meaningfully increase"

quarters.commentary: Management swiftly executed the pivot to 1P inventory ownership, unlocking margin accretion and top-line expansion.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Management demonstrates disciplined execution by setting conservative short-term quantitative benchmarks while maintaining clear medium-term targets (e.g., 60% QC CAGR, 3,000 dark stores), consistently delivering or exceeding operational milestones before raising long-term guidance.
